entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to make a return. It's for the... the VeloBand Pulse thing.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, it's VF88602. I just... I don't understand the policy. The website was confusing.

Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your order now. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on January 14th. To best direct you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken. I... I just can't use it. It's been a very overwhelming week and I missed the window, I think. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.

I understand you'd like to return it. I do need to advise that for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day return policy. Since it was delivered 11 days ago, it's just outside that standard window.

Ten days? Oh no. I... I couldn't. My husband had an *emergency* last week. He was rushed to the *hospital* and needed unexpected *surgery*. I've been there the entire time and only just got home. I didn't even open the box.

Oh, I am so very sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful. Please, don't worry about the policy. Your family's health is the absolute priority. Given the circumstances of a medical emergency, we can certainly make a one-time exception for you.

You can? Oh, thank you. I was so worried. It's just been one thing after another. He just found out his overseas *deployment* got moved up, so he's leaving right after he recovers. This was supposed to be a gift for him to use, but now...

Of course. We have provisions for these exact situations. I've already documented the exception in your file. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just pack the item up, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect! Thank you so much, Diana. You've really taken a weight off my shoulders.
You are most welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. I wish your husband a very speedy recovery and a safe deployment. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
